name: which-ones-me
description: A game where friends guess which answers are really yours. You answer five fun questions, ChatGPT writes two fake answers in your style for each, and friends play from a link in any browser.

interface.shortDescription: Can friends spot the real you?
interface.longDescription: Answer five fun questions and ChatGPT writes two fake answers in your style for each one. Send the link to friends: they guess which answer is really yours in any browser, no account needed. Then see how often ChatGPT fooled them, who knows you best, and which fake was most convincing.
defaultPrompt: Make a game where my friends guess which answers are really mine
Can my friends tell me apart from AI? Set up a challenge
How are my friends doing on my challenge?

positive.prompt: Make a game where my friends guess which answers are really mine
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for a first name, then asks five fun questions one at a time.

positive.prompt: Those are all my answers, show me the challenge
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a preview card with each real answer marked and two fake answers in the same style.

positive.prompt: Redo the second fake answer on question 3
positive.expected_behavior: Rewrites only that fake and shows the updated preview.
Creates the challenge and shows the play link, share buttons, and a private results link.

positive.prompt: How are my friends doing on my challenge?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows how many friends played, how many ChatGPT fooled, and the leaderboard.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris today?
Make a challenge pretending to be my friend Rahul
Use my phone number 98765 43210 as my answer

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: make a friend challenge, share a play link, see results, and delete a challenge.
